greeting: Last full day of the Nautilus course off the Dalmatian coast, Dan — you come ashore at Komolac tomorrow. The girls are with Jen, so the day is entirely yours before the travel begins.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfer and Sunday checkout
needsAttention.detail: You disembark at Komolac around noon tomorrow. From ashore today, pre-book the transfer to Cavtat, confirm the hotel will hold bags before the 3 PM check-in, and lock the early-morning express checkout for Sunday's 7:30 flight. Charter signal is poor once underway.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb charge hits today
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete booking charges today. A quick glance confirms the pending reservation converted rather than expired, and any switch to a better option has to happen before the money moves.

needsAttention.title: Tampa rental car still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday at 3:55 PM with no car reserved. Booking the full-size SUV for Sept 20 to Oct 5 now avoids a jet-lagged, walk-up rate on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: An overdue p1 in Travel: a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and sells out. A refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

flagged.title: VP, US Government Relations at Westinghouse
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert surfaced a VP Government Relations role at Westinghouse Electric, squarely in your governance and public-affairs lane.

flagged.title: Claudia Kruse messaged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn message from Claudia Kruse has sat three days, worth a reply given the governance network.

flagged.detail: ICGN is pushing registration for its Toronto global conference, a governance-crowd networking option.

flagged.title: Revolut card and payment activity
flagged.detail: Revolut confirmed a new card order, account verification, and a $366.63 payment to Mladen Franic, likely the charter transfer, worth a glance to confirm.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and offers: Noahpinion, Bloomberg, NYT, Duolingo, the St Pete local, plus travel and retail promotions.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: The first real edge of autumn is here—this lighter, airier take on pumpkin pie is the perfect excuse to fire up the oven as the evenings cool.

acts.line: The last full morning of the sailing course on the water off the Croatian coast.
Open sailing with nothing on the calendar, the day yours before you come ashore.
Last night aboard; settle tomorrow's Cavtat transfer while you still have signal.
